notes.title: Bugged Achievements
notes.content:
Unfortunately, the dev times for whole game and secret levels are unobtainable, which super sucks. This is because two levels weren't given a Dev time, my bad, and for one, the mechanics are acting up. I don't understand it, I'll have to look into it.

My unfortunate solution is temporarily removing these achievements, so that you guys can still 100% it. This isn't very satisfying, and I apologise. Shout out to Cutty Flame though, what a champion.

notes.title: Some little polish-y details
notes.content: Added some sound effects, vfx, in places I thought they may be missing.

notes.title: Some more helpful guides in early levels
notes.content: To teach you the proper way to wingboost straight up. Try Divine Kingdom 2 if you want a refresher!

notes.title: Broken tiles are supposed to be unwalljumpable
notes.content: but I managed to break this a day before release, sorry 'bout that. Just want to spell it out so nobody gets confused: the broken brick etc tiles are intended to block walljumping on them.

notes.title: A revamped tutorial
notes.content: With some animated raquels floating around, as well as some more sections to show the different ways of using the wings.

notes.title: Sorry, bosses
notes.content:
They got nerfed :( 
In particular, Abalone in Kingdom 6 should be quicker to hit, and also some other mysterious boss won't softlock the player offscreen anymore.

notes.title: Removed the fps counter in the corner, whoops that's not supposed to be there
notes.content: And besides, why would you need a tracker to tell you it's silky smooth 60fps, right guys?

notes.title: Some secret fixes to secret places
Another quick patch. I'm on a roll here.
notes.content: Occasionally the interaction popup would remain. I told it firmly not to, and it worked.

notes.title: Watch the Developer Needlessly Suffer Levels He Should Really Know By Now
